system.description:
Beginning at 2nd level you have learned to turn your Medical Chakra from being a source of healing, into a source of harm. Your medical Chakra has become a deep green with hints of purples and blacks. It has become toxic to the immediate area and to creature you use it on.

When you roll initiative, you begin radiating this hazardous chakra known as your Malignant Aura, which lasts until the end of an encounter. While radiating your Malignant Aura, you gain access to Blight. Once per turn you can gain Blight, either by spending a Bonus action to manifest a charge of it, or by inflicting ranks of Envenomed or Corroded on a creature as a result of a Class feature or Jutsu you cast. You can maintain up to 3 Blight and can spend them to do the following abilities. If an ability calls for a saving throw, you use your Ninjutsu save DC for the contest;

Septic Detonation. As an Action, by spending 1 Blight, you target a creature with ranks of Envenomed forcing the poison inside to violently react to your chakra. The target takes 1d12 poison damage for each rank of Envenomed they have.

Rotting Pulse. When you cast a Jutsu with the Medical keyword that deals damage as part of a saving throw, by spending 1 Blight, you rapidly make the chakra more hazardous. The jutsu’s damage becomes Poison or Necrotic and on a failed save, the affected creatures all become Blighted.

Malignant Barrier. As a Bonus action, by spending 1 Blight, you manifest a shield of corrosive chakra that shields you until the beginning of your next turn. The first time a creature makes a melee attack against you, they become Corroded.

roll.note: Bonus Action, or when you inflict Envenomed or Corroded.
Septic Detonation and the other Blight abilities (Ninjutsu save DC).
